gui.template-mod.config.title: Template Mod Settings
gui.template-mod.config.tab_client_toolt: Client-only settings, stored locally and never synced to the server.
gui.template-mod.config.tab_admin_toolti: Server-authoritative settings. Viewing requires the server to allow it; changing requires operator permission.
gui.template-mod.config.save_tooltip: Save every changed setting on both tabs.
gui.template-mod.config.close_tooltip: Close this screen. Prompts to save first if anything is unsaved.
gui.template-mod.config.visualization_to: Choose how the example server-driven progress value is displayed on your HUD.
gui.template-mod.config.visualization_co: The fill color used by both HUD visualizations. Click the swatch or this button to open the color picker.
gui.template-mod.config.progress_rate_la: How much the example progress value advances every server tick, from 0 to 1. JSON key: progressRate
gui.template-mod.config.progress_rate_va: Fraction of the progress bar filled per server tick.
gui.template-mod.config.allow_read_only_: If enabled, non-operator players can view (but never change) these settings. JSON key: allowNonOpReadOnlyView
gui.template-mod.config.admin_no_permiss: You do not have operator permission to view these settings.
gui.template-mod.config.admin_read_only_: You do not have operator permission to change these settings.
gui.template-mod.confirm_save.title: Unsaved Changes
gui.template-mod.confirm_save.message: You have unsaved changes. What would you like to do?
gui.template-mod.confirm_save.save_and_c: Save every pending change, then close this screen.
gui.template-mod.confirm_save.close_with: Discard every pending change and close this screen.
gui.template-mod.confirm_save.cancel_too: Return to the settings screen with every pending change intact.
gui.template-mod.color_picker.title: Choose a Color
